claim_scope.p0: Student independent enactment may expose teacher skill blindspots not surfaced by equal-budget teacher self-probing.
claim_scope.p1: Verified student-induced blindspot repairs may yield persistent teacher held-out task gains.
claim_scope.meta_rsi: Meta-controller improvement requires learner reset and an outer train/test separation; no meta-learning result yet.

teacher.student_selection: one weaker, one cross-family; validate their skill ceiling on real task families
teacher.privacy_guard: Teacher never gets final test answers, raw test trajectories, or oracle scripts.

student_trial_arms.S1: Student with teacher's current skill contract
student_trial_arms.S2: Student with development-set verified reference explanation (capacity check only)
student_trial_arms.T0: Teacher baseline with same task and environment budget; student traces hidden

counterfactuals: same parent teacher independent probe with equal environment calls
student cross-family probe with identical lesson
patch exactly one skill clause then verify repeatability

split_contract.D_seed: Teacher initial verified successes and failures; lesson extraction
split_contract.D_probe: Student teaching episodes; never final test
split_contract.D_meta: Optional meta-policy development rewards, disjoint by root task family
split_contract.D_test: Frozen final evaluation only; task-level outcomes are not used for training

initial_pilot.goal: validated teacher blindspot discovery vs same-budget self-probe
teacher held-out net gain paired against strong baselines

stop_conditions: all alleged teacher gaps are explained by student ceiling or environment faults
equal-budget teacher self-probe has equal or better validated discovery and teacher gain
teacher gains vanish with conversation reset
positive results appear only in manually injected failures or reused tasks
no significant advantage over shared editor and simple skill induction
deployment_note: The published webpage and JSON are research plans, not experimental outcomes or approvals.
